title: 2019-03-12 Meeting notes - AWS support plan for DEXF accounts
content:
Date

Attendees

Goals

Explain recommendation for AWS support plan.

Decide if DEXF should upgrade AWS support plan for production account.

Discussion items

TimeItemWhoNotes
5min

has created strategy for AWS support plan. Accoding to  DEXF only has Developer plan even for production account. Should production account be upgraded to Business to match SLA. 


Recommendation is that DEXF should align SLA with AWS support plan which would imply upgrading the production account to business support plan.

What is the real benfint of paying for higher level of support.
 Business support plan does not imply different (better) service up time. Business support plan gives possibility to have support from AWS within specified time and outside office hours.

Since Jayway is AWS partner with high competence within AWS the benefit of buying business support is not clear.

Decision: Offer DEXF team to upgrade support plan. If not required by team let DEXF production account stay on Developer support plan.





Action items

1 complete  Offer DEXF team to upgrade support plan. Notify attendees of result. 2 complete   Bring recommendation to other teams in
